designationHistory.indexText: The Steens Mountain Cooperative Management and Protection Act of 2000 directed the Secretary of the Interior to designate the Steens Mountain Cooperative Management and Protection Area in Harney County, Oregon.

authority.citation: Public Law 106-399, title I, sec. 101, 114 Stat. 1655, 1658

designationHistory.note: Sec. 101 says 'The Secretary shall designate'; the date is the law's approval date, which the BLM page also gives.
